name: livetennis-redbot
author: Live Tennis API
short: Live tennis scores cogs by livetennisapi.com
description: Cogs for Red-DiscordBot published by Live Tennis API (livetennisapi.com), the vendor of the Live Tennis API. Currently ships LiveTennis: live tennis scores, match detail, fixtures and player lookups.
install_msg:
Thanks for adding the Live Tennis API repo!
Install the cog with `[p]cog install livetennis-redbot livetennis`, then set a free API key with `[p]set api livetennis api_key <your key>` (free key: <https://livetennisapi.com/subscribe/free>).
Issues and suggestions: <https://github.com/livetennisapi/livetennis-redbot/issues>
